title: Bound each side of a task-sync commit delta separately and report its limit by name on the export paths
outcome: Bound each side of a task-sync commit delta separately and report its limit by name on the export paths
acceptance: A valid delta whose old and new sides each stay within the folder limit is read, even when together they exceed 128 MiB
On the export paths a delta limit refusal is reported as the limit, not as a task difference
